invariants.rationale: The method throws an exception if name is null, so this is always true at method exit.
The method throws an exception if resource is null, so this is always true at method exit.
The method uses type as a key for resources and in constructor calls, so it must not be null at method exit.
After execution, the resources map must have an entry for the provided type.
The typeResources map for the given type must contain the provided name after adding.
